name: tail-ipam
description: Allocate and plan Tailscale address space through a local, comment-preserving registry and read-only control-plane inventory.
sanitization: TAILSCALE_SANITIZE=off|identity|strict sanitizes rendered output after collection; a non-off environment value overrides --sanitize. Device names, addresses, and routes; tailnet routing keys; and site names are replaced. strict is accepted for cross-tool flag compatibility and is currently equivalent to identity for tail-ipam. calc split output (subnets and parent CIDR) is not sanitized because it contains no tailnet-derived data. Set TAILSCALE_SANITIZE_KEY (64 hex characters) for stable tailnet-scoped placeholders; without it placeholders are artifact-scoped.

flags.name: sanitize
flags.usage: output sanitization level: off|identity|strict (a non-off TAILSCALE_SANITIZE value overrides this flag)

flags.name: schema
flags.usage: print the machine-readable tool schema (JSON) and exit
